summary: Korn Ferry filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing a conditional redemption of its 4.625% Senior Notes due 2027. The company will redeem the entire $400 million principal amount on August 18, 2026, at 100% of par plus accrued interest, subject to completion of debt financing with gross proceeds of at least $400 million. The condition may be waived at the company's sole discretion. This is a debt refinancing event rather than a special situation involving equity, and the registrant acts as issuer. Watch for financing completion and redemption timing.
